title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of ILO constituents and regional and sub-regional constituents and partners (AUC and RECs in particular) to develop and implement labour migration policies and programmes

description.narrative: The ILO in Africa aims to enhance labour statistics to track SDG progress, focusing on data collection, new methodologies, and analytical publications. Guided by the Abidjan Declaration, the ILO will support Africa's priorities like youth employment and gender equality. Key strategies include establishing regular data collection systems, creating impactful training programs, and developing effective dissemination systems. RAF 903 aligns with frameworks like the African Union's Agenda 2063 and the Global Compact on Migration, promoting fair labour migration governance. The ILO will build on past achievements, support capacity building in various areas, and improve the governance of labour migration and decent work opportunities in Africa. Key initiatives include endorsing AU declarations, creating digital training platforms, publishing reports on women migrant workers, and developing social protection strategies. The ILO will also support the establishment of a Continental Mechanism for Multilateral Cooperation on Labour Migration.
